name: Lust Theory: Season 3
source:
Play as a 20 year old guy whose life is about to take a wild turn. After being stuck in a time loop and living out all your wild fantasies, your time to face the consequences finally came. 

How will you navigate through familiar relationships and mend the ones you screwed up? 

[From [url=https://www.incetongames.com/lust-theory-season-3]the official site[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名20岁的年轻人，他的生活即将发生巨大转变。在陷入时间循环并实现你所有的疯狂幻想之后，你面对后果的时刻终于到来了。

你将如何处理熟悉的关系并修复那些你搞砸的关系？

[摘自[url=https://www.incetongames.com/lust-theory-season-3]官方网站[/url]]
